document.original_request: Replace the selected gene with the supplied cassette and retain both 50 bp homology arms.

steps.why: Read the supplied synthetic linear reference.
Read the actual selected cargo source.
Read the actual complete donor template; do not create it from the model.
Compute the independent source-bound expectation before preparation.

Export the exact original assay background.
Export the exact edited assay background.
Export the actual PCR/assembly product for independent recomputation.
Bind actual reference-file hashes and junction primers into the D11 file protocol.
